text.formatted: The merrow can breathe air and water.
text.plain: The merrow can breathe air and water.

text.formatted: The merrow makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws or harpoon.
text.plain: The merrow makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws or harpoon.

text.formatted: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.
text.plain: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

text.formatted: _Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:_ +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it must succeed on a Strength contest against the merrow or be pulled up to 20 feet toward the merrow.
